questions.subject: Social Science
questions.stem:
Read the following statements carefully:
1. A fertilizer maker in India who blends nitrogen (N), phosphate (P) and potash (K) into complex fertilizer has to buy the potash part of the mix entirely from abroad.
2. This is because the country does not have any reserves of commercially usable potash or potassium compounds in any form.
Select the correct answer. (A) Both the statements are true and statement 2 explains statement 1. (B) Both the statements are true but statement 2 does not explain statement 1. (C) Statement 1 is true but statement 2 is false. (D) Both the statements are false.

answerScheme.modelAnswer: Both the statements are true and statement 2 explains statement 1.
